title: Midnight Crunch Keto Bites
description: Crunchy keto bites made with midnight oats and blade almonds, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the midnight oats, blade almonds, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together the crunch butter and sugar-free sweetener.
Add the vanilla extract to the crunch butter mixture and mix well.
Pour the crunch butter mixture over the oat mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Use a cookie scoop or your hands to shape the mixture into small balls.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
